contracts.claim: Created Expo authoring files retain requested identity, entrypoint and supported dependency versions.
Creation rejects paths outside selected root before any effects.
Creation requires a valid reverse-domain bundle identifier before writing.
Each capsule retains its source root and exact manifest, excluding generated paths, confidential suffixes and links.
Builder metadata persists only the allowed fields and signing references, without passwords.
Compiler preferences validate before writing and persist exactly, without signing passwords.
Downloaded bytes match the expected digest before atomic promotion; mismatch never promotes a destination.
Persisted plist exactly matches identity and iPhoneOS platform metadata.

Assets stage inside the app www directory and root-relative links become local links.
Failure receipts strip terminal control codes and retain bounded useful text.
Mobile authoring, status and compiler configuration commands retain requested workspace, app identity, current recognition and preferences.
Real retained iPhone/iPad/Mac bundles pass independent byte, archive, Mach-O and signature integrity checks; C7 copy mutations must fail without changing originals. No Apple-host trust claim.
C7 captures the real authenticated Scroll Study UI in iPhone/Mac/iPad frames, operates controls and records sandbox storage limits; no native Apple execution claim.
